title: Cambodian villagers gather at Prey Chan/Ban Nong Ya Kaeo and Ban Nong Chan border sites
reason: Read report describes distinct gatherings demanding that Thailand respect the border MOU and protect Cambodian homes/land; no demand on Cambodia’s own government is established.
notes: Report gives about 50 at one fence and about 200 at a separate location; do not aggregate. Thai demonstrations described later in the article are not part of this Cambodian event.

notes: The actual event is reported from Thai military statements and the captured results do not document a demand to Cambodia’s own government. Keep separate from 17 and 21 September reports.

title: Cambodian civilians protest Thai barriers near Prey Chan
